notes: New: a Review page (spaced repetition): words you get wrong twice in their last 5 readings become cards, tested in Blind at the right time.
New: Review cards show only a few lines before the spot, fewer as you improve; Next skips or ends a card; Help me learn after a fail.
New: before your first word, the first "next word" voice command plays the ayah before (or says the surah name); the second shows the word.
New: more ways to say the replay voice command, for example "a'idha marra" or "'awedli".
Fix: a slow ta'awwudh and basmala no longer hide the first words of the surah in Blind and Hidden.
Change: the Progress table shows how many days ago each page was revised, one line per page.
Change: on wide screens the mushaf text is centred instead of spreading the words apart.
